description: Files copied into tests/vendor/ from other repositories, each pinned by SHA-256. tests/unit/vendor.test.mjs checks them offline: every file under tests/vendor/ is listed here (or is one of the folder's own files), and every listed file has its SHA-256. tests/vendor/check-upstream.mjs compares them with the upstream copies and prints a note when upstream differs, never a failure. A refresh copies the new files, updates their SHA-256 and the commit, and runs the tests that use them.

They hold expected values only (SHA-256 digests, chain ids, Merkle roots, byte counts) and generated test data. The two verb shards (texts/11-verb-00.txt, texts/12-verb-01.txt) are WordNet 3.0 glosses (Princeton University) under the WordNet licence, LICENSE-WORDNET.txt, copied with them.

sources.licence: CC0-1.0. The seven suites of this source are normative there: Owl's biomesh.js at 7f45f35 and the independent oracle agreed on every case. The rest of SHD-CCP-core is GPL-3.0 and none of it is copied here.

sources.pending: 762e6bc is the S2 commit of SHD-CCP-core (the RFC 07 suites added after 150a50f), not yet merged into main. When it merges, compare these files with main (check-upstream.mjs), copy any that changed, set commit to the merge commit and fold this source into shdccp2-contract. The tamper suites name Owl's strict verifier at 903c00d in their `source`; SHD-CCP-core repins that to Owl's published commit, which changes `source` only, never a case.
sources.licence: CC0-1.0, as for shdccp2-contract (the same contract_vectors/LICENSE, unchanged at 762e6bc; vendored once, as shdccp2-contract/LICENSE). Five of these suites are normative at 762e6bc (two independent implementations agreed on every case and SHD-CCP-core's lock pins them): shdccp2_limits, engram1_keys, rng_mulberry32, merkle_rules_same_bytes and shdccp2_tamper. shdccp2_tamper_open is draft: RFC 07 section 12.5 leaves the first failing check of its ten values open. Not vendored: rfc6962_lists and attest1_profile, which scripts/biomesh-core.js does not implement (RFC 6962 trees; the ATTEST/1 and SEAL/1 profile, which Owl verifies from Phase 4, decision D9).
